description.en: The ID of the application that you want to scale out. You can call the ListApplication operation to query the application ID. For more information, see [ListApplication](~~149390~~).

description.zh: 需要扩容的应用实例分组。获取应用实例分组，请参见[QueryApplicationStatus](~~149394~~)。
description.en: The ID of the instance group where the application you want to scale out is deployed. You can call the QueryApplicationStatus operation to query the group ID. For more information, see [QueryApplicationStatus](~~149394~~).

description.zh: 指定ECU进行扩容。获取ecuid，请参见[ListScaleOutEcu](~~149371~~)。多个ECU，用半角逗号（,）分开。
description.en: The ID of the elastic compute unit (ECU) that corresponds to the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance to be added to the instance group for scale-out. You can call the ListScaleOutEcu operation to query the ECU ID. For more information, see [ListScaleOutEcu](~~149371~~). Separate multiple ECU IDs with commas (,).
